name: Single Exponential Smoothing (ETS Model)
formula: L_t = alpha * y_t + (1 - alpha) * L_{t-1}, yhat_{t+h} = L_t
code_expression: level = alpha * y[t] + (1 - alpha) * level; forecast[h] = level
basis: Standard industry metric (Exponential Smoothing, Hyndman et al.)
notes: Handles non-seasonal, stationary baseline demand series. Level initialization defaults to mean of first 3 periods.

name: Holt's Linear Trend Exponential Smoothing
formula: L_t = alpha * y_t + (1 - alpha) * (L_{t-1} + b_{t-1}); b_t = beta * (L_t - L_{t-1}) + (1 - beta) * b_{t-1}; yhat_{t+h} = L_t + h * b_t
code_expression: level = alpha * y[t] + (1 - alpha) * (level + trend); trend = beta * (level - prev_level) + (1 - beta) * trend; forecast[h] = level + (h + 1) * trend
notes: Captures sustained growth or contraction trends across network demand nodes.

name: Croston's Method for Intermittent Demand
formula: If y_t > 0: z_t = alpha * y_t + (1 - alpha) * z_{t-1}, p_t = alpha * q_t + (1 - alpha) * p_{t-1}; yhat = z_t / p_t
code_expression: if y[t] > 0: non_zero_demand = alpha * y[t] + (1 - alpha) * non_zero_demand; interval = alpha * periods_since_last + (1 - alpha) * interval; rate = non_zero_demand / max(interval, 1.0)
notes: Separately tracks non-zero demand size and inter-arrival periods. Prevents overstocking on sporadic demand nodes.

name: Quantile Pinball Loss (P10 / P50 / P90)
formula: L_q(y, yhat) = max(q * (y - yhat), (1 - q) * (yhat - y))
code_expression: loss = np.maximum(q * (y - y_hat), (1 - q) * (y_hat - y))
notes: Produces probabilistic uncertainty bands. P10 represents downside risk, P90 represents surge risk.

name: Mean Absolute Scaled Error (MASE)
code_expression: naive_mae = np.mean(np.abs(np.diff(history))); mase = mae / max(naive_mae, 1e-6)
thresholds: MASE < 1.0 (Model beats naive random walk benchmark)
notes: Scale-independent forecast accuracy metric. Essential when comparing multi-echelon products with vastly different volume scales.

name: Mean Absolute Error (MAE)
formula: MAE = (1 / n) * sum_{t=1}^n |y_t - yhat_t|
code_expression: mae = float(np.mean(np.abs(actuals - predictions)))
notes: Direct absolute error metric across validation hold-out window.

name: CUSUM Change-Point Detection Statistic
code_expression: s_pos = max(0, s_pos + (val - mean - k)); s_neg = min(0, s_neg + (val - mean + k)); if s_pos > h or abs(s_neg) > h: break_detected
notes: Detects structural shifts in demand level, triggering regime reclassification and model re-selection.

name: Regime Volatility Ratio & Trend Slope
formula: CV = sigma / mu; Trend_Slope = (y_end - y_start) / (N * mu)
code_expression: cv = float(np.std(series) / max(np.mean(series), 1e-6)); slope = float((series[-1] - series[0]) / (len(series) * max(np.mean(series), 1e-6)))
notes: Maps time series characteristics into discrete operating regimes to drive model selection.

name: External Signal Demand Lift Enrichment
formula: Enriched_Demand_t = Baseline_Demand_t * (1.0 + sum(Signal_Lift_i * Confidence_Weight_i))
code_expression: lift_factor = sum(s.magnitude_pct * s.confidence_weight for s in applicable_signals); enriched_forecast = [val * (1.0 + lift_factor) for val in baseline_forecast]
basis: Explicitly defined by project/business requirements (Engineering Safeguard bounded)
notes: Applies external market signals to baseline forecast under strict bounding safeguards.

name: MILP Total Network Cost Objective Function
formula: Min Z = sum_{i,j} (C_ij * x_ij) + sum_j (F_j * y_j) + sum_k (P_unfulfilled * u_k) + sum_{i,j} (T_sla_penalty * penalty_ij)
code_expression: solver.Minimize(solver.Sum(trans_cost[i,j] * flow[i,j] for i,j in lanes) + solver.Sum(fixed_cost[j] * open_dc[j] for j in dcs) + solver.Sum(unmet_penalty * unmet[k] for k in markets) + solver.Sum(sla_penalty * sla_slack[i,j] for i,j in lanes))
thresholds: unmet_penalty = 10,000 (prohibitive penalty to ensure maximum fulfillment)
notes: Google OR-Tools CBC/SCIP/GLOP linear programming solver formulation. Guaranteed global optimum for convex relaxation.

name: Plant Supply Capacity Constraint
formula: sum_j x_ij <= Supply_Cap_i, for all plants i
code_expression: solver.Add(solver.Sum(flow[i,j] for j in dcs) <= plant_capacity[i])
notes: Prevents dispatching volume exceeding production plant ceiling.

name: DC Throughput Capacity & Facility Open Indicator
formula: sum_k x_jk <= Throughput_Cap_j * y_j, y_j in {0, 1}, for all DCs j
code_expression: solver.Add(solver.Sum(flow_dc_market[j,k] for k in markets) <= dc_capacity[j] * open_dc[j])
basis: Standard Operations Research MILP Big-M Formulation
notes: Links binary DC selection with continuous flow throughput.

name: Market Demand Fulfillment Balance Constraint
formula: sum_j x_jk + u_k = Demand_k, u_k >= 0, for all markets k
code_expression: solver.Add(solver.Sum(flow_dc_market[j,k] for j in dcs) + unmet_demand[k] == demand[k])
notes: Ensures all market demand is routed through DCs or explicitly logged as unfulfilled with high penalty.

name: Network Fill Rate (%)
formula: Fill_Rate = (Total_Demand - Total_Unfulfilled) / Total_Demand * 100
code_expression: fulfilled = total_demand - total_unmet; fill_rate = (fulfilled / max(total_demand, 1e-6)) * 100.0
notes: Core service delivery metric across network.

name: DC Capacity Utilization (%)
formula: Utilization_j = (Throughput_Volume_j / DC_Capacity_j) * 100
code_expression: utilization = (throughput_volume / max(capacity, 1.0)) * 100.0
notes: Determines bottlenecks and triggers rebalancing or expansion recommendations.

name: Cost Optimization Savings Delta (Absolute & %)
formula: Cost_Savings = Baseline_Cost - Optimized_Cost; Savings_Pct = (Cost_Savings / Baseline_Cost) * 100
code_expression: cost_diff = baseline_total_cost - optimized_total_cost; savings_pct = (cost_diff / max(baseline_total_cost, 1.0)) * 100.0
notes: Authoritative financial metric driving business case recommendations.

name: Facility Resilience Exposure Index (REI)
formula: REI_j = 0.5 * (Financial_Impact_j / Max_Financial_Impact) + 0.5 * (Service_Loss_j / Max_Service_Loss)
code_expression: norm_cost = cost_exposure / max(max_network_cost_exposure, 1e-6); norm_service = service_loss / max(max_network_service_loss, 1e-6); rei = 0.5 * norm_cost + 0.5 * norm_service
basis: Explicitly defined by project/business requirements (Simchi-Levi Resilience Model)
notes: Evaluates the vulnerability of each facility under simulated N-1 node disruption (Time-to-Survive & Time-to-Recover).

name: Network Aggregate Resilience Score
formula: Network_Resilience = 1.0 - max_{j in Facilities} (REI_j)
code_expression: max_rei = max((f.rei for f in facility_results), default=0.0); network_resilience = max(0.0, min(1.0, 1.0 - max_rei))
notes: Ensures single points of failure directly dictate the macro resilience posture of the entire network.

name: Governed Risk Factor (RF = P + REI - P * REI)
formula: RF = P + REI - (P * REI)
code_expression: rf = p + rei - (p * rei); rf = max(0.0, min(1.0, rf))
inputs: P: Disruption Probability in [0.0, 1.0] (from External Signals / Historical Telemetry)
REI: Resilience Exposure Index in [0.0, 1.0] (from Authoritative Resilience Engine)
thresholds: HIGH_RISK: RF >= 0.70 (Triggers Tier 2 / Tier 3 Governance Escalation)
basis: Mathematically derived probabilistic union of independent events (P(A U B) = P(A) + P(B) - P(A n B))
notes: Core mathematical bridge combining external disruption likelihood P with internal structural vulnerability REI.

name: Risk Exposure Financial Value
formula: Value_at_Risk = RF * Total_Throughput_Value_at_Node
code_expression: var_inr = rf * node_throughput_value
basis: Expected Value / Value at Risk Formulation
notes: Quantifies monetary risk exposure to inform executive governance authorization.

name: Safety Stock Coefficient & Reorder Point
formula: SS = z_score * sqrt(Lead_Time * sigma_d^2 + d_mean^2 * sigma_LT^2); ROP = d_mean * Lead_Time + SS
code_expression: safety_stock = z * np.sqrt(lt * (d_std**2) + (d_mean**2) * (lt_std**2)); rop = d_mean * lt + safety_stock
notes: Determines buffer inventory required at each DC under demand and supply lead time uncertainty.

name: Scope 3 Logistics Carbon Footprint
formula: CO2_kg = sum_{i,j} (Flow_ij * Distance_ij * Mode_Emission_Factor_ij) / 1000.0
code_expression: total_emissions = sum(flow * dist * emission_factor / 1000.0 for lane in active_lanes)
inputs: emission_factor (Road Diesel = 62.0 g CO2/t-km, Rail = 18.0 g CO2/t-km, Air = 500.0 g CO2/t-km)
basis: Standard industry metric (GLEC Framework / IPCC Guidelines)
notes: Computes carbon emissions to evaluate green routing and ESG trade-offs against cost.

name: Center of Gravity (COG) Coordinates
formula: Lat_cog = sum(w_k * Lat_k) / sum(w_k); Lon_cog = sum(w_k * Lon_k) / sum(w_k)
code_expression: cog_lat = sum(m.demand * m.lat for m in markets) / max(total_demand, 1e-6); cog_lon = sum(m.demand * m.lon for m in markets) / max(total_demand, 1e-6)
basis: Standard Operations Research Center of Gravity / Weber Problem formulation
notes: Screens optimal candidate coordinates for greenfield DC placement.

name: Cumulative Distance & On-Time Service Level
formula: Weighted_Distance = sum(Flow_jk * Distance_jk) / sum(Flow_jk); SLA_Adherence = sum(Flow_within_SLA) / Total_Flow * 100
code_expression: weighted_avg_dist = sum(f.volume * f.distance for f in flows) / max(total_volume, 1e-6); sla_pct = (flow_on_time / max(total_volume, 1e-6)) * 100.0
notes: Tracks lead-time compliance across customer destination zones.
